The proposition keeps the 'what appears to be' hedge and 'without fail'. All four excerpts are exact substrings with correct publishers, dates and context relations. 'Unresolved' matches the agreed assessment.

'Essentially all' faithfully renders 'basically any'. The rationale's points on empirical inputs, cross-checks, uncertainty and 26% coverage are supported by e1 and e2.
